Name: Simple More Items Fishing Treasure
Author: Xsyy
Description:
[center][size=6][color=#D8B4FE][b]🎣 Simple Fishing Treasure[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]💜 If you enjoy my mods, please consider endorsing this mod. Thank you for your support! ⭐[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]This mod is made for PC. Android compatibility has not been tested.[/color][/size]
[color=#D8B4FE][size=6] Requested by [b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/Harold45]Harold45[/url][/b]. [/size][/color][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Give successfully recovered fishing treasure chests a chance to contain [b]extra loot[/b], with separate controls for chance, item selections and stack quantities. Your original treasure stays intact.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]✨ Extra Treasure, Your Settings[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]• Defaults to a [b]20% chance[/b] for [b]1–3 bonus selections[/b], giving [b]1–3 items per selection[/b] within native stack limits.
• Uses a balanced pool of resources, bait/tackle, seeds/ordinary forage, and gems/geodes.
• Supports compatible registered mod items and an editable exclusion list.
• Optional ordinary light and magnet rings unlock after mine level 40; this option starts [b]Off[/b].
• Keeps native item names, artwork and loaded retextures. Large rewards continue through native overflow menus.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#D8B4FE][b]⚙ Settings
[/b][/color][/size][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/53870/53870-1791990570-1012829420.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to adjust minimum/maximum bonus chance, bonus selections and units per stack from [b]1–100[/b]. Equal minimum and maximum values give a fixed setting. Invalid ranges are clamped and the maximum is raised to the minimum.

[b]Chance[/b] is sampled within your range, then checked once per recovered chest. [b]Selections[/b] control how many items are chosen after success; [b]units per stack[/b] control each chosen item’s quantity. At 100/100 chance, an eligible bonus attempt always succeeds. This does not guarantee a particular item.

Toggle supported mod items and ordinary rings separately. Enter excluded IDs separated by commas or spaces; raw IDs and IDs beginning with (O) are accepted. Exclusions always win. Settings text is included in twelve languages.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]⚖ Loot & Progression[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Category weights are [b]45% resources, 25% bait/tackle, 20% seeds/ordinary forage and 10% gems/geodes[/b], reweighted when a category is empty. Certain gold resources, gems/geodes and optional rings require mine progress. Rings and other non-stackable items have quantity 1.

Furniture, wallpaper/flooring, machines, decorative objects and special quest/progression pickups are excluded. Modded items need compatible ordinary-item metadata; not every custom item is supported. Version 1.0 does not include a broad random-everything mode or other weapons/clothing.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#A7F3D0][b]📦 Requirements & Installation[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6[/b] and compatible [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI 4.x[/url]. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] is optional.

Extract the [b]SimpleFishingTreasure[/b] folder from the ZIP into your game’s [b]Mods[/b] folder, then launch through SMAPI. Without GMCM, edit the generated config.json while the game is closed. Remove this mod’s folder to stop future bonuses; it stores no custom save progression. Follow the supplying mod’s instructions before removing any other mod that added items you want to keep.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#67E8F9][b]🧪 Compatibility & Current Limits[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]• Does not increase treasure-chest appearance, automate fishing, or award loot for lost chests.
• Isolated native checks cover the recovered-treasure callback, repeat protection, overflow menus, SSE 1.27 Level 100 reward hooks and Auto Fishing 1.1 reward-scope hooks. [b]Live gameplay and full-modpack testing are still pending.[/b]
• Automation that handles only the original chest may require manual collection of overflow pages. Its own full-inventory or discard rules still apply.
• Multiplayer, split-screen and physical controller input have not been verified.
• At narrower UI widths, a long GMCM label can crowd its checkbox.
• Translations are AI-assisted and have not been proofread by native speakers. Please test a copied save before regular use.[/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=5][color=#FDE68A][b]🐛 Bug Reports & 💡 Suggestions[/b][/color][/size][/center]

[center][size=4][color=#E5E7EB]Please share reports and ideas here on this mod’s page.

[b]For bugs:[/b] include the mod version, game/SMAPI versions and platform; what happened versus what you expected; steps to reproduce; a [url=https://smapi.io/log]shared SMAPI log link[/url]; and a screenshot or short video if helpful. For loot issues, include your relevant settings and any fishing/loot mods.

[b]For suggestions:[/b] tell me what you would like changed or added and how it would improve the mod.[/color][/size][/center]
